topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: Virtually no investment will give you returns to match an 18% interest rate on your credit card.
question: Misconception: Investing first is usually better because investment returns will outpace the interest on high-interest credit card debt.
answer: Investment returns are not guaranteed to match the interest rate on high-interest credit card debt. The source says virtually no investment will match an 18% credit card rate, so it recommends paying off credit card debt before investing.
